title: One Year On: Progress, Gaps, and Possibilities for LGBTQ+ Inclusion
description: This year's LGBTQ+ roundtable will compare where we were at last year's roundtable, where we are now, and tackle key issues LGBTQ+ professionals are facing in the ever-changing social and political landscape. The hosts will present a series of topics, which attendees will be free to discuss, sharing their thoughts, insights, and experiences in a supportive environment.
session_takeaway: Understand what LGBTQ+ professionals are currently experiencing in the industry.
Discover practical ways to navigate and mitigate workplace negativity.
Gain examples of changes to EDI practices around the world and how to implement them.
